title: NIST WebBook: Sulfur dioxide gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation
summary: The WebBook lists 2 gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation row(s) for Sulfur dioxide. Reviewed rows and experimental rows are both quoted.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation rows for Sulfur dioxide (CAS 7446-09-5) print: -296.81 ± 0.20 kJ/mol, method Review, reference Cox, Wagman, et al., 1984, comment: CODATA Review value (experimental or compiled row) | -296.84 kJ/mol, method Review, reference Chase, 1998, comment: Data last reviewed in June, 1961 (calculated or reviewed row). The page mixes reviewed or averaged rows with rows tied to a named experiment or compilation. A Review or AVG method is an evaluation. A Ccb method is combustion calorimetry, as the WebBook method code is linked. This card does not average the rows into a new number.
